```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : ¬ 3 ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 := by
  intro h
  cases n mod 3 with q r
  have h1 : (n ^ 2 + 1) % 3 = (r ^ 2 + 1) % 3 := by rw [mod_eq_iff_div_eq_floor, mod_add_right]
  rw [h1] at h
  have h2 : (r ^ 2 + 1) % 3 = 0 := by rw [mod_eq_iff_div_eq_floor, h]
  cases r with
  · exact absurd h2 (by rw [mod_self_three]; exact rfl)
  · exact absurd h2 (by rw [mod_self_three]; exact rfl)
  · exact absurd h2 (by rw [mod_self_three]; exact rfl)
```
